title: Release Notes for Safari Technology Preview 256
content:
Safari Technology Preview Release 256 is now available for download for macOS Golden Gate and macOS Tahoe. If you already have Safari Technology Preview installed, you can update it in System Settings under General → Software Update.

This release includes WebKit changes between: 323398@main…324653@main.

Accessibility

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed list marker text generated with the content property not being exposed in the accessibility tree. (323578@main) (189838099)
  • Fixed VoiceOver being unable to reach the content of an iframe nested inside an iframe with role="none" or role="presentation". (323749@main) (189901948)

Animations

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed scroll-driven animations drawing a translate keyframe of none as the element’s own translate value. (323583@main) (189882533)
  • Fixed: Improved performance of scroll-driven animations by avoiding style invalidation on animation updates when timing is unchanged. (324449@main) (190709310)

CSS

New Features

  • Added support for text-combine-upright on ::marker. (323582@main) (189912173)
  • Added support for continue: collapse with line-clamp, which is now set by the line-clamp shorthand. (323734@main) (190023170)
  • Added support for font-palette-mix() on Cocoa platforms, allowing font color palettes to be blended. (324044@main) (190133191)

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed ::highlight() styles not being found past anonymous boxes. (323588@main) (148245032)
  • Fixed text zoom being applied twice to font sizes specified with font-relative units. (324195@main) (188215447)
  • Fixed aspect-ratio interpolation being inverted in vertical writing modes. (323584@main) (188500448)
  • Fixed document.fonts.ready never resolving when an unused @font-face has a failing local() source followed by a url() source. (323883@main) (189243828)
  • Fixed layout not updating inside a nested scroll container after its classic scrollbar disappears when using line-clamp with an absolutely positioned descendant. (324368@main) (189451731)
  • Fixed :dir() matching for a <bdi> element without a dir attribute so it updates when its ancestor’s direction changes. (323439@main) (189472957)
  • Fixed light-dark() inside image-set() incorrectly accepting a bare string as an image URL. (323705@main) (189627071)
  • Fixed CSSStyleSheet.replaceSync() on a detached constructed stylesheet appending rules instead of replacing them, which could also corrupt other stylesheets sharing the same contents. (323736@main) (189634428)
  • Fixed CSSMatrixComponent.toMatrix() returning the component’s internal DOMMatrix for 3D matrices, so mutating the result no longer changes the component. (323948@main) (189653766)
  • Fixed a positioned inline-block after the line-clamp clamp point remaining visible. (323402@main) (189672687)
  • Fixed -webkit-min-device-pixel-ratio and -webkit-max-device-pixel-ratio media features serializing as min--webkit-device-pixel-ratio and max--webkit-device-pixel-ratio. (323731@main) (189687289)
  • Fixed a flex item with aspect-ratio and a calc() height resolving to a zero flex base size. (323464@main) (189753886)
  • Fixed CSSStyleDeclaration.setProperty() to override an existing !important custom property when called without a priority. (324083@main) (189765758)
  • Fixed a table flex item with borders being wider than its content and borders. (323471@main) (189766215)
  • Fixed line-clamp: auto to account for collapsed block-end margins when finding the clamp point. (323468@main) (189767053)
  • Fixed a table flex item with borders or padding and a non-auto min-width being too wide. (323466@main) (189768684)
  • Fixed the grid-template shorthand so empty [] line names before a row’s leading line names no longer overwrite the previous row’s track size. (323665@main) (189769011)
  • Fixed line-clamp: auto to find the clamp point before balancing content. (323481@main) (189774214)
  • Fixed calc() negation of a typed-arithmetic product flipping the sign of every factor. (323577@main) (189779826)
  • Fixed object-fit: none and object-fit: scale-down to size an image without natural dimensions against its content box. (323503@main) (189844957)
  • Fixed the content size suggestion of grid items with a preferred aspect ratio to be clamped correctly in grid layout. (323655@main) (189848571)
  • Fixed: Changed the auto value of the continue property to normal to match the specification. (323557@main) (189893145)
  • Fixed the grid layout engine to compute collapsed tracks for repeat(auto-fit). (323658@main) (189937668)
  • Fixed a regression where word-break: keep-all allowed many incorrect line breaks. (324360@main) (189973862)
  • Fixed the placement of outside list markers in vertical writing modes. (323721@main) (190017212)
  • Fixed grid layout to collapse empty repeat(auto-fit) tracks and their gutters. (323843@main) (190062840)
  • Fixed grid layout to use the transferred size suggestion for the automatic minimum size of grid items. (323855@main) (190065310)
  • Fixed the intrinsic minimum block size of a column flex item being incorrectly clamped by a smaller max-block-size. (323872@main) (190077511)
  • Fixed selectors with mixed-case attribute names failing to match HTML elements in XHTML documents when used with ancestor combinators. (323947@main) (190089102)
  • Fixed CSSUnitValue for container query length units reporting a number type instead of a length type. (323949@main) (190095825)
  • Fixed the linear() easing function rejecting a percentage written before the number in a control point. (323951@main) (190097099)
  • Fixed calc() type inversion overflowing its exponent, which could produce incorrect results. (323873@main) (190099592)
  • Fixed CustomStateSet add() and delete() invalidating style when the set does not change. (323982@main) (190183292)
  • Fixed the CSSCounterStyleRule.name setter not updating the name getter or cssText. (324049@main) (190185460)
  • Fixed a grid item with a non-auto min-block-size overflowing the grid when the grid shrinks and the item’s content wraps. (324127@main) (190192125)
  • Fixed quote marks generated by open-quote and close-quote not taking the ::first-line style. (324380@main) (190252758)
  • Fixed a stretched item in a column-reverse wrapping flex container ignoring its main-axis auto margin. (324398@main) (190272880)
  • Fixed calc-size(auto, size) making an aspect-ratio box wider than its max-content size when a child has a percentage height. (324649@main) (190727077)
  • Fixed an absolutely positioned box inside content after the line-clamp clamp point not being laid out. (324457@main) (190732934)
  • Fixed an orthogonal block-level box inside an inline box incorrectly adding its top and bottom margins to its container’s width. (324652@main) (190767962)

Canvas

New Features

  • Added the lang attribute to CanvasTextDrawingStyles. (324596@main) (143391479)
  • Added support for fontKerning, fontStretch, fontVariantCaps, and textRendering in canvas text drawing styles. (324110@main) (190388702)
  • Added support for the inherit value of the direction attribute in CanvasTextDrawingStyles. (324603@main) (190908024)

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed black pixel artifacts when drawing a Canvas 2D image through WebGL after applying a gradient. (324218@main) (189661903)
  • Fixed drawing a VideoFrame in BGRX format to ignore the alpha component. (323809@main) (189794952)

Forms

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed appearance: base-select option hover styling being clipped when rotated transforms are applied. (323903@main) (171933742)
  • Fixed the date picker not using the correct appearance when automatic dark mode is applied. (324046@main) (188747558)
  • Fixed <selectedcontent> elements so they update at the correct times in an enhanced <select>. (324149@main) (189480559)
  • Fixed deselecting the selected option of a dropdown <select> so it always selects the first option. (323929@main) (190021473)
  • Fixed: Updated the default <select> styles to match upstream changes for better interoperability with other browsers. (324587@main) (190724295)

HTML

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed the HTML parser to treat <search> as a special element, so it closes an open <p> element correctly. (323915@main) (190117661)

Deprecations

  • Removed support for the rightmargin and bottommargin presentational attributes on <body>. (323444@main) (189727708)

Images

New Features

  • Added support for object-fit, object-position, and object-view-box on SVG documents in <embed> and <object>. (323822@main) (190118512)

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed the drag image to match the rendered image when dragging an image. (323399@main) (189759601)
  • Fixed the size of images without natural dimensions, such as SVG images, when they are written to the pasteboard. (323529@main) (189873103)
  • Fixed the placement of an SVG image that specifies only a width when used with object-fit: none or object-fit: scale-down. (323567@main) (189909016)
  • Fixed inconsistent sizing of SVG images that have a width or height of 0. (323884@main) (190171855)
  • Fixed an SVG image with a width or height less than 1 failing to load. (324048@main) (190315280)
  • Fixed an issue where 8-bit grayscale and CMYK images were converted to 16-bit images when drawn, wasting memory. (324389@main) (190488500)
  • Fixed image URLs containing a fragment directive so that only the fragment before the directive is used, such as box in foo.svg#box:~:param(--bg, green). (324650@main) (190961757)

JavaScript

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed Math.sumPrecise returning an incorrect result for -Number.MAX_VALUE. (324530@main) (178356895)
  • Fixed a module worker evaluating its entry script a second time when the worker imports its own URL. (323507@main) (188303176)
  • Fixed GetPrototypeFromConstructor to read prototype before calling GetFunctionRealm, matching the specification. (323408@main) (189773842)
  • Fixed an incorrect optimization in the DFG compiler that could produce wrong results for code using the logical NOT operator (!). (323639@main) (189876762)
  • Fixed an incorrect result in optimized code for the integer conversion used by operations such as Math.trunc() and array index handling. (323624@main) (189876905)
  • Fixed an incorrect optimization in the DFG compiler for right shift operations, which could produce wrong results when the shift count exceeds the 32-bit mask. (323595@main) (189886500)
  • Fixed an issue where calling RegExp as a function could be incorrectly optimized into creating a new regular expression object. (323678@main) (189954203)
  • Fixed await a ** b and the use of await as an identifier in a module to correctly throw a SyntaxError. (323662@main) (189958423)
  • Fixed labelled function declarations so they are declared in the enclosing scope. (323675@main) (189972133)
  • Fixed the "use strict" directive to reject strict mode reserved words as parameter and function names. (323677@main) (189973461)
  • Fixed TypedArray and ArrayBuffer constructors to throw a RangeError for a negative length. (323740@main) (189976051)
  • Fixed parsing of let, async of, and destructuring declarations in for loop heads. (324319@main) (190415260)
  • Fixed includes, indexOf, and lastIndexOf on BigInt64Array and BigUint64Array matching BigInt values outside the element type’s range. (324313@main) (190436212)
  • Fixed Array.prototype.push called with no arguments to throw an error when the array’s length is not writable. (324204@main) (190437846)
  • Fixed private class brand installation to happen before class elements are evaluated. (324222@main) (190509577)
  • Fixed module code to report an error when an import or export declaration redeclares a var. (324223@main) (190509652)
  • Fixed Map, Set, WeakMap, and WeakSet constructors to accept undefined or null as the iterable when optimized by the DFG compiler. (324418@main) (190657930)
  • Fixed an issue where private name checks (#x in obj) were compiled incorrectly by the DFG compiler. (324397@main) (190663814)
  • Fixed an issue where an overwritten length property on sloppy-mode arguments objects was not converted using ToLength. (324407@main) (190676161)
  • Fixed Array.prototype.sort calling bound comparator functions incorrectly when sort is inlined. (324512@main) (190788820)

Media

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed the caption font size menu in media controls not changing the caption font size. (324327@main) (137012134)
  • Fixed a high CPU usage issue where media rendering repeatedly busy-looped the main thread while a seek or flush was pending. (323669@main) (188769771)
  • Fixed encrypted media playback enqueuing samples that were blocked on a key and submitted before a flush or seek. (323532@main) (189588721)
  • Fixed text-decoration styles not being applied to the inner background element of WebVTT cues. (323874@main) (190139268)
  • Fixed the spatial video renderer not coming back after media controls are re-enabled. (323986@main) (190170810)
  • Fixed Media Source Extensions playback permanently stalling after a video track is flushed. (324032@main) (190198848)
  • Fixed the video viewer’s native controls incorrectly applying YouTube-specific behavior. (324150@main) (190242515)
  • Fixed previously enabled subtitle tracks not being re-enabled when switching the subtitle menu to off inline and then back on in fullscreen. (324522@main) (190417162)
  • Fixed audio sample timing to respect trimmed timing information. (324387@main) (190519875)
  • Fixed MediaRecorder losing its final data when stopped while a timeslice data request was in flight. (324405@main) (190561436)
  • Fixed WebVTT cue parsing to require exact keyword matches for alignment settings, rejecting values that only begin with a valid keyword. (324444@main) (190662853)
  • Fixed unicode-bidi styles set with ::cue not applying to the WebVTT cue background. (324479@main) (190682540)
  • Fixed WebVTT cue line positioning so the snap-to-lines step is computed from the cue’s first line box, correcting vertical cue rendering. (324447@main) (190685928)
  • Fixed an issue where media time values with equal negative numerators and different timescales were compared in the wrong order. (324514@main) (190698694)
  • Fixed WebCodecs AudioDecoder to decode Opus content with more than two channels. (324615@main) (190709046)
  • Fixed FLAC audio decoding always failing in WebCodecs. (324640@main) (190923178)

Networking

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed WKWebsiteDataStore reusing its connection pool after proxyConfigurations changes, which caused requests to bypass the new proxy. (324143@main) (179411114)
  • Fixed the image loader’s lookup of available images to use the partitioned memory cache. (323594@main) (189778787)
  • Fixed non-ASCII Last-Event-ID request header values being UTF-8 encoded twice for EventSource requests. (323875@main) (189977696)
  • Fixed EventSource to no longer treat a UTF-16 byte order mark as valid. (324395@main) (190634672)
  • Fixed XMLHttpRequest JSON responses to always be decoded as UTF-8. (324483@main) (190717643)

Performance

New Features

  • Improved performance by caching document.querySelector() results. (323620@main) (189789022)
  • Improved navigation performance by starting navigations in a cached Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy process before the response arrives. (323631@main) (189790518)

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed a regression where filtered layers with composited ancestor clips allocated oversized filter buffers. (324517@main) (180473291)
  • Fixed slow repaints and long hangs when registering many small highlights with the CSS Custom Highlight API. (324157@main) (186478678)

Rendering

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed selection gaps not being repainted when clearing a selection in vertical-rl writing mode. (323935@main) (14699394)
  • Fixed font fallback to select fonts and glyphs by canonical equivalence. (323560@main) (165656837)
  • Fixed glyph bounds for complex text to include shaped glyph origins, preventing clipped or mispositioned text. (323777@main) (184235153)
  • Fixed frames that use custom scrollbars continually resizing. (323645@main) (186222322)
  • Fixed composited layer bounds to account for the filter outsets of a layer and its ancestors, preventing filtered content from being clipped. (323864@main) (187924396)
  • Fixed missed overlap for layers inside a stacking-context composited scroller nested in another composited scroller. (323793@main) (189067776)
  • Fixed incorrect inline layout after removing content when partial layout damage started at an inline item of the removed box. (323458@main) (189801792)
  • Fixed composited child elements being misplaced when their compositing ancestor gains or loses a child clipping layer. (323487@main) (189836116)
  • Fixed an issue on macOS where scroll bars in nested iframes kept the old style when the system scroller style changed. (324289@main) (189965521)
  • Fixed uninitialized blurred areas being drawn for blur styles on Cocoa platforms. (324350@main) (190254152)
  • Fixed the text width cache returning incorrect widths when kerned and unkerned versions of a font are used repeatedly. (324093@main) (190360672)
  • Fixed videos being clipped to the wrong corner-shape when an ancestor also has a rectangular clip. (324288@main) (190402270)
  • Fixed an issue where an animated SVG <img> scaled below its natural size left repaint trails. (324343@main) (190485225)
  • Fixed blurred areas being drawn with uninitialized content for some blur styles. (324350@main) (190563103)
  • Fixed the last-line baseline of a block container whose last in-flow child is a scroll container so that the baseline sits at the child’s bottom margin edge, preventing misaligned text. (324653@main) (190772090)

SVG

New Features

  • Added support for referrerPolicy on the SVG <a> element. (323659@main) (135952757)
  • Added support for the SVG 2 text layout algorithm. (324088@main) (190288583)

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed <textPath> not being laid out again when the d attribute changes on a referenced <path> that has display: none. (323938@main) (189579922)
  • Fixed animated percentage values in SVG text y and dy resolving against the viewport width instead of its height. (323847@main) (189739351)
  • Fixed the SVG timeline resetting to 0 when it is paused and seeked before it begins. (324084@main) (189739894)
  • Fixed <use> copies of an SVG <a> keeping the old target after the target attribute changes. (324087@main) (189740877)
  • Fixed SMIL full clock values with more than 1,193,046 hours overflowing during parsing. (323932@main) (189760312)
  • Fixed SVG <image> elements so a referenced SVG image treats its own root preserveAspectRatio as none. (323568@main) (189909967)
  • Fixed SMIL repeat(n) conditions never firing after seeking past repeat iterations. (323927@main) (189986502)
  • Fixed the SVGLength.value setter to convert font-relative units using up-to-date style. (324072@main) (189988135)
  • Fixed an issue where changing the children of an SVG <mask> used by CSS mask-image did not repaint the masked element. (324026@main) (190101845)
  • Fixed SVG <font-face> rules being registered in a non-deterministic order. (324089@main) (190353779)
  • Fixed repaint rect computation for SVG text with vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke so the stroke is repainted correctly per text run. (324095@main) (190363935)
  • Fixed composedPath() in an event listener on a <use> element exposing its user agent shadow root. (324329@main) (190528878)
  • Fixed <feImage> to place and draw its referenced image the same way as an SVG <image> element. (324592@main) (190881899)

Security

New Features

  • Added console logging when Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy or Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy isolation is expected but not achieved. (324426@main) (190563075)

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed clicking in a cross-origin iframe incorrectly activating same-origin descendants of its ancestors. (323897@main) (181549362)
  • Fixed a regression where creating a <select> element triggered a Content Security Policy style-src-attr violation. (324283@main) (189869066)
  • Fixed frames in an about:blank popup not being treated as secure contexts. (323985@main) (190126073)
  • Fixed data: documents so that only top-level data: documents are treated as non-secure contexts. (324086@main) (190309192)
  • Fixed Geolocation to be blocked in non-secure contexts. (324227@main) (190455029)

Web API

New Features

  • Added support for the estimated line item type in Apple Pay JS. (324470@main) (187363098)
  • Added support for VideoFrame.copyTo() converting to RGB on the fly. (323866@main) (189797745)
  • Added support for the colorSpace option in VideoFrame.copyTo(). (323952@main) (189902908)

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed document.fullscreenEnabled and document.webkitFullscreenEnabled to return consistent values. (323549@main) (102937855)
  • Fixed element.checkVisibility() to work for unslotted elements. (324155@main) (118648432)
  • Fixed the AAC AudioEncoder producing an incorrect decoder config description. (324436@main) (164878480)
  • Fixed getComposedRanges() over-rescoping the range when a passed shadow root is a descendant of the boundary’s shadow tree. (324385@main) (180810983)
  • Fixed the Navigation API so navigation.back() and navigation.traverseTo() on the main frame land on the correct session history entry after a subframe has navigated. (324589@main) (187959384)
  • Fixed element.checkVisibility() returning false for <option> and <optgroup> elements in a list box. (323990@main) (189211521)
  • Fixed getBoundingClientRect() returning incorrect boxes for <option> and <optgroup> elements in a list box. (324424@main) (189227828)
  • Fixed VideoFrame, AudioData, EncodedVideoChunk, EncodedAudioChunk, MediaStreamTrack, and MediaStreamTrackHandle so they can no longer be cloned or transferred into a different agent cluster. (323558@main) (189747796)
  • Fixed VideoFrame.copyTo() to succeed for BGRX and RGBX frames. (323569@main) (189797144)
  • Fixed Media Session artwork images that have no intrinsic size, such as SVG without width, height, or viewBox, so they are sized using the default sizing algorithm with a 512×512 ideal artwork size. (323461@main) (189822449)
  • Fixed VideoFrame.copyTo() to allow converting to an RGB format when VideoFrame.format is null. (323953@main) (189932876)
  • Fixed an issue where a page navigated to about:blank lost its history entry when the next navigation occurred. (324566@main) (190237322)
  • Fixed an issue where a previous tap could cause a later tap to be treated as a hover. (324259@main) (190357260)
  • Fixed Blob‘s text() to no longer sniff UTF-16 byte order marks when decoding. (324134@main) (190382159)
  • Fixed a navigation to the current URL reporting the wrong navigationType when document.domain is set. (324269@main) (190420617)
  • Fixed Blob‘s text() to decode its data as it arrives. (324356@main) (190449988)
  • Fixed location.replace() on a frame in another process so it no longer adds a session history entry. (324264@main) (190512610)
  • Fixed an issue where setInterval() could be scheduled using a stale cached next fire time. (324432@main) (190658646)
  • Fixed an issue where navigating an iframe away from its initial about:blank document by clicking a link added a history entry. (324562@main) (190687356)
  • Fixed requestIdleCallback() idle period scheduling by using the actual frame period at 60Hz, so idle periods are no longer scheduled right before the frame deadline. (324545@main) (190768899)

Deprecations

  • Deprecated XML external entities, and added a console warning when they are used. (324200@main) (184870654)

Web Extensions

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed tabs.onUpdated to not report unchanged values and to report rapid property toggles. (324357@main) (84204907)
  • Fixed Safari showing no error when the declarativeNetRequest rule_resources JSON is not a list. (323963@main) (146113788)
  • Fixed calling action.setPopup() with an invalid popup path leaving the popup unrecoverably broken. (324142@main) (166048992)
  • Fixed non-repeating browser.alarms alarms not being removed from the alarm map after firing. (323750@main) (173399426)
  • Fixed action.setIcon() throwing an error when tabId is null instead of setting the global icon. (324277@main) (176975795)
  • Fixed runtime.openOptionsPage() so it focuses the existing options page when it is already open. (324541@main) (177344808)
  • Fixed browser.alarms.clearAll() to return a Promise<undefined>. (323534@main) (187115327)
  • Fixed alarms.onAlarm to report the next scheduledTime for repeating alarms when the background page was unloaded. (323752@main) (189951123)
  • Fixed an issue where an extension’s own content rule lists were applied to pages other than its extension pages. (323863@main) (190036270)
  • Fixed content blocker rules that combine request-method with a top URL or frame URL condition not working. (324050@main) (190316684)

Web Inspector

New Features

  • Added display of ::slotted() styles in the Styles sidebar of the Elements tab. (323654@main) (29035069)
  • Added support for exposing Shadow DOM parts in the Elements tab. (323685@main) (100250231)
  • Added reporting of rendered font character ranges. (324359@main) (143740107)
  • Added visual distinction for private methods in the Console. (324399@main) (190664079)

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed ::placeholder styles for input elements not showing up in the Styles sidebar. (323670@main) (56514581)
  • Fixed a regression where console.group and console.groupCollapsed did not always encapsulate grouped messages. (323613@main) (142028751)
  • Fixed toString being called twice when logging an object with the console. (323668@main) (169883641)
  • Fixed a discrepancy where Web Inspector and WebDriver reported different computed roles for the same element. (323965@main) (179841782)
  • Fixed: Improved Web Inspector performance by no longer iterating all rendering frame records to calculate the overview graph height. (323614@main) (181921116)
  • Fixed the Elements tab to collect CSS variables for both styles and keyframes. (323598@main) (189934225)
  • Fixed the Elements tab to correctly parse animation names when editing keyframes. (323600@main) (189934494)
  • Fixed console screenshots appearing in read-only Timelines recordings. (323599@main) (189934498)
  • Fixed markers appearing in read-only Timelines recordings. (323601@main) (189934611)
  • Fixed the Timelines tab to stop updating the time when capture is inactive. (323604@main) (189936051)
  • Fixed Web Inspector to handle URLs with an empty host. (323603@main) (189936372)
  • Fixed Web Inspector to parse URLs with ports and blob: URLs in stack traces. (323606@main) (189936384)
  • Fixed the Timelines tab to show capture progress only for the active recording. (323607@main) (189936469)
  • Fixed the Elements tab to correctly parse animation keys when editing keyframes. (323608@main) (189936580)
  • Fixed the Console’s await convenience being included in code completion requests. (323605@main) (189936602)
  • Fixed the Timelines tab to preserve imported heap snapshots when exporting recordings. (323609@main) (189936631)
  • Fixed stack trace popovers to reposition when the Web Inspector window is resized. (323611@main) (189936790)
  • Fixed Web Inspector to distinguish the source code of multiple Worker instances. (323612@main) (189936821)
  • Fixed awaited evaluation in the Console to preserve the selected call frame scope. (323610@main) (189937067)
  • Fixed the Elements tab to refresh styles after a CSS grouping rule edit fails. (323616@main) (189937131)
  • Fixed the Elements tab to also track inherited CSS variable dependencies. (323623@main) (189939830)
  • Fixed Web Inspector to report errors that occur while loading source maps. (323653@main) (189956520)
  • Fixed the Elements tab overlay for SVG <text> nodes appearing in the wrong position. (324055@main) (190158402)
  • Fixed Web Inspector so that edits to a style sheet mutate the live style sheet contents. (323979@main) (190235686)
  • Fixed links to inline CSS in Web Inspector incorrectly adding the starting column of the <style> element. (323998@main) (190248080)
  • Fixed Web Inspector so that the client nodes of a -webkit-canvas are always an array. (323999@main) (190248443)
  • Fixed Web Inspector so that a script is associated with its resource even when the MIME type is incorrect. (324003@main) (190249110)
